definitions.explanation: The same size as the real person or object, used especially for figures, statues, and representations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{等身|とうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a life-size Buddha statue at the temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フィギュア→フィギュア：07081_figyua⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A life-size figure is on display.

examples.japanese: ⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧で⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to be your authentic self.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蝋人形|ろうにんぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいて→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧、⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ようだった。
examples.english: Life-size wax figures were lined up in the museum, looking just like real people.

notes:
Used on its own mainly in set compounds such as {等身|とうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧ (life-size Buddha statue) and {等身|とうしん}⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (life-size statue). In everyday Japanese it is almost always used in the compound ⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧ (life-size). The literal meaning is physical size equal to the actual body, but it has a popular figurative use meaning "natural, authentic, unpretentious" — being one's true size without exaggeration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — life-size; true-to-life
- ⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ — one's true/authentic self
- ⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧ — life-size standee/panel
- ⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧ — live authentically

USAGE:
⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ is a popular expression meaning to live without pretension, accepting oneself as one is. This figurative use is extremely common in self-help, personal essays, and everyday conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実物大|じつぶつだい}→実物大：16710_jitsubutsudai⟧ — actual size; similar meaning but emphasizes matching the real object, used more for objects than people
- ⟦{原寸大|げんすんだい}→原寸大：20738_gensundai⟧ — full scale, actual size; more technical, often used in design and architecture
